stories.name: Oracle AI Debt Concerns
stories.blurb: Oracle's massive borrowing to fund its AI ambitions is alarming credit markets and investors as debt costs rise and free cash flow turns negative.

stories.name: Oracle AI agent push
stories.blurb: Oracle is rolling out agentic AI capabilities across its Fusion applications and cloud platform to speed implementations and automate enterprise work.

stories.name: Oracle stock outlook
stories.blurb: A series of analyst and earnings previews debating whether Oracle's beaten-down stock is a bargain poised to rally on accelerating cloud growth.

stories.name: Project Jupiter Delays
stories.blurb: Oracle is invoking force majeure and facing delays on its massive $165 billion Project Jupiter AI data center in New Mexico, rattling investors and partner Bloom Energy.

stories.name: Adobe stock outlook
stories.blurb: A series of headlines debating whether Adobe's stock is a bargain or still risky as it bets on freemium growth.

stories.name: AI debt bubble
stories.blurb: Investors and analysts are warning that massive AI infrastructure spending, increasingly funded by debt and off-balance-sheet commitments, could pose serious credit risks to Big Tech.

stories.name: Oracle AI cloud financing
stories.blurb: Oracle is raising tens of billions in debt and equity to fund its AI cloud build-out while projecting aggressive long-term revenue and cash flow targets.

past.name: Oracle data center delay
past.blurb: Oracle's data center delays and force majeure are weighing on tech stocks amid rising Treasury yields and oil prices.

past.name: Oracle Q1 Earnings Beat
past.blurb: Oracle's fiscal Q1 results topped analyst expectations, driven by surging cloud infrastructure and AI-related demand, prompting raised profit guidance and a jump in its stock price.

4.text: Oracle launched a $20 billion capital raise ($10 billion stock, $10 billion senior notes), exhausting its entire fundraising cap through fiscal 2030 just days after promising to limit new raises. Shares fell roughly 7-15%, wiping over $60 billion in market value, as bonds and stocks both sold off on AI debt concerns.

7.text: Deloitte formed a new Oracle business group expanding their alliance across AI, cloud, data, and cybersecurity. Credo and Oracle advanced optical transceiver telemetry standards, and Chubu Electric deployed its 10 millionth Oracle-based smart meter.

5.text: Oracle shares have fallen sharply this year (down about 26% YTD and roughly half over the past year) while carrying billions in negative free cash flow. At its Investor Day, Oracle reaffirmed a $90 billion FY2027 revenue target and at least $225 billion by 2030, projected free cash flow positivity in H2 fiscal 2028 and over $30 billion in fiscal 2029; Stephens upgraded the stock to Overweight with a $213 target, and two desks set $400 targets.

8.text: A Texas lawmaker called for pausing new data-center projects pending safeguards, and analysts said Democratic midterm wins pose little federal risk to data-center construction but more risk at state and local levels. Oracle is affected as a data-center operator.

11.text: AI infrastructure spending is driving hyperscaler capex, GDP growth, and debt concerns, with analysts warning of a possible correction as AI prices and usage moderate. Oracle is not mentioned in these articles.

12.text: Oracle priced $20 billion in concurrent offerings: 86.2 million shares at $116 each (about $9.9B net) and five senior note tranches due 2029–2046 (about $10B net), closing November 4 for general corporate purposes. It also filed a shelf registration and said $20 billion covers data-center expansion through fiscal 2030.
